column1: # Rule: object types, input types, enums and unions are a class; interfaces
# are an interface; scalars are a type_alias; directive definitions, named
# operations (query/mutation/subscription X) and fragments are a function.
# Fields, arguments, enum values and input fields are not definitions; an
# `extend ...` adds to a type and does not define it again; an anonymous
# operation (`query { }` or a bare `{ }`) has no name. A symbol is on the line
# of the keyword and name, never on the line of the """description""" above it.
